name: node-pipewire
description: NodeJS native module written in Rust and Typescript to interact with Pipewire

scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/binding/napi-v6 && cargo-cp-artifact -nc dist/binding/napi-v6/index.node -- cargo build --locked --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.build-native: mkdir -p dist/binding/napi-v6 && cargo-cp-artifact -nc dist/binding/napi-v6/index.node -- cargo build --locked --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.build-cross: tsc && mkdir -p dist/binding/napi-v6 && cross build --locked --target $TARGET && cp target/$TARGET/debug/libnode_pipewire.so dist/binding/napi-v6/index.node
scripts.build-cross:release: tsc && mkdir -p dist/binding/napi-v6 && cross build --locked --target $TARGET --release && cp target/$TARGET/release/libnode_pipewire.so dist/binding/napi-v6/index.node
